description:
"I could teach the AI what 0243 is — and it worked. Suddenly, like magic." ✨

Jenny Wong on the breakthrough: every major LLM failed at Cantonese tone-matching, until she met the 0243 godfather, Master Wong Chi-wah, and found a one-sentence mapping that taught the AI the system. Suddenly it just got it — and Cantolyrics.ai was born.

Part 3 of 3 on the 0243 system.

From EP11 of the Hong Kong AI Podcast with Jenny Wong — founder of Cantolyrics.ai.
